title: Mystery of the Burning Tent
subtitle_source: subs_resolved/0909.txt, subs_resolved/0910.txt (743 dialogue lines, full transcript read)
notes: Recurring detective-cast (Conan, Detective Boys, Kogoro/Ran, Inspector Yuminaga, Managing Officer Kuroda, teacher Wakasa Rumi) omitted by convention; Kuroda's and Wakasa's ongoing season-arc suspicion subplot plays out in these episodes but is unrelated to this case's culprit. After being exposed, Ashizawa takes a Detective Boys member hostage with the box cutter and is subdued by Kuroda; omitted here as it involves only omitted-convention nodes. case_type: murder. Old low-fidelity `cases/ep909-910_mystery_of_the_burning_tent.json` held up on re-read: culprit (Ashizawa), victim (Urushibara), and the two forensic clues (tape/DNA, canvas fibers on the cutter) all match the transcript. Minor precision fixes only: the binding material is medical/athletic tape (not 'plasters'), and the culprit cuts INTO the tent to rig the device (not 'out' to escape) -- he enters and exits through the same knife-cut, leaving the zipper untouched and locked exactly as the victim had left it, which is what made the tent look like a locked room.

persons.name: Fumiaki Urushibara
persons.occupation: university basketball player (defense specialist), Shiraami University

attrs.died_of: smoke inhalation and burns in a fire staged to look like a drunken accident
attrs.blackmail_leverage: knew Ashizawa had asked him to injure Danno; threatened to expose it unless paid once Ashizawa turned pro
attrs.state_at_time_of_death: heavily drunk (five servings of curry, plus drinking alone in his tent), passed out

persons.name: Sumito Ashizawa
persons.occupation: university basketball player, rising star scouted by professional teams

attrs.confession: admits to setting the fire; states he had no personal grudge against Urushibara but was being blackmailed
attrs.tell: removed the athletic tape from his own right hand mid-visit and never explained the fresh mud on his right elbow

attrs.cleared_reason: first to visit; tent lights were already off and the shadow-squat device had not yet been started

persons.name: Kuninori Danno
persons.occupation: former team ace, now basketball team manager

attrs.injury: partial vision loss in his right eye from Urushibara's elbow during practice, ended his playing career
attrs.cleared_reason: last to visit, after the shadow-squat device was already running and Urushibara was unresponsive

attrs.description: newly opened campsite; shared dinner and argument took place here

attrs.features: entrance zipped shut and locked from the moment Urushibara went in to read comics; culprit entered/exited through a separate knife-cut in the tent wall, never touching the zipper

attrs.mechanism: two candles joined end-to-end by a bamboo skewer through holes poked in candles balanced on stacked comic books; as each end burns down it tips up and down like a seesaw, casting a rising-and-falling shadow that mimics squats, and eventually ignites nearby cloth/books
attrs.materials_source: built entirely from candles, matches, and comic books already inside Urushibara's tent
attrs.concealment: extra candles were scattered around the device afterward so its melted parts would blend into the wreckage

objects.name: Athletic tape moved to victim's left hand

attrs.trick: removed from Ashizawa's own right hand and used to bind Urushibara's hands behind his head so his silhouette would look like it was doing squats
attrs.inconsistency: witnesses agree Urushibara had tape only on his right hand while alive (a basketball habit); his corpse had tape on both hands
attrs.expected_forensic_result: victim's skin and hair, consistent with Ashizawa's DNA, expected on the tape's adhesive side

attrs.used_for: cutting into the tent wall to enter and rig the device without touching the locked zipper, then used again afterward to threaten a hostage once Ashizawa was exposed
attrs.expected_forensic_result: tent canvas fibers expected on the blade

clues.desc: Visit-order testimony: Furuoka (1st) found the tent already dark and quiet; Ashizawa (2nd) also claims it was dark, but the shadow-squats started right after he left; Danno (3rd) found the squats already in progress -- narrows the device's start to Ashizawa's own visit.
Unexplained fresh mud on Ashizawa's right elbow, in a posture consistent with reaching through a knife-cut in the tent wall, contradicts his claim it came from an unrelated trip earlier that night.

edges.detail: asks Urushibara to elbow Danno during practice so Ashizawa can take the starting spot
elbows Danno in the eye during practice, ending his competitive playing career
drunkenly demands money once Ashizawa goes pro, or he'll expose the injury conspiracy

edges.motive_type: concealment (silencing a blackmailing accomplice in the injury conspiracy)

edges.detail: binds Urushibara's hands behind his head with tape while he is passed out drunk, so his shadow will look like it's doing squats

edges.method: staged accidental tent fire via a timed candle-seesaw ignition device
